BiblicalUsage: tsach means dazzling, i.e. sunny, bright, evident. It appears 4 times in Scripture, including Song of Solomon 5:10 and Isaiah 32:4.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe tsach shows how carefully God chose His words, and this one earns its place.
